name: fillout-forms
label: Fillout Forms
description: Create interactive forms and automate workflows with Fillout

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
1. Go to your Fillout account settings.
2. Click on "Developer settings".
3. Generate and copy your API key.
4. Paste it here.

getFormResponses.label: Get Form Responses
getFormResponses.description: Fetch all responses for a Fillout form, with optional filters.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max number of submissions to retrieve (1-150).

status.label: Status
status.description: By default, only finished submissions are returned. Select "In Progress" to get unfinished submissions instead.

includeEditLink.label: Include Edit Link
includeEditLink.description: Include a link to edit the submission.

search.label: Search
search.description: Filter for submissions containing this text.

getSingleResponse.label: Get Single Response
getSingleResponse.description: Retrieves a specific submission from a form.

submissionId.label: Submission
submissionId.description: Select from the 50 most recent submissions for the chosen form.

includeEditLink.label: Include Edit Link
includeEditLink.description: Include a link to edit the submission.

findFormByTitle.label: Find Form by Title
findFormByTitle.description: Finds an existing forms by title.

title.label: Form Title
title.description: The (partial or full) title of the form to search for.
